[Extraplanar Supplication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4554) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Nephilim" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=518" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 80

</column>

---

You call upon divine power to place a benediction upon your allies or a malediction upon your foes. Choose either [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25) or [_bane_](/Spells.aspx?ID=18). You can cast the chosen spell once per day as a 1st-rank divine [innate spell](/Rules.aspx?ID=279).
name: Extraplanar Supplication
